```{r}
library(CellChat)
library(patchwork)
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
sub_clusters <- c()
srt_subset <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sub_clusters)
data.input <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data
meta <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data
meta$labels <- paste0("clust_", meta$sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5)
meta$samples <- factor(meta$sample.name)
cellchat <- createCellChat(object = data.input, meta = meta, group.by = "labels")

```

```{r}
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse
showDatabaseCategory(CellChatDB)
```

```{r}
dplyr::glimpse(CellChatDB$interaction)

```

```{r}
cellchat_keys <- list(c("Secreted Signaling", "ECM-Receptor", "Cell-Cell Contact"),"CellChatDB v2")
CellChatDB.use <- subsetDB(CellChatDB, search = cellchat_keys, key =  c("annotation", "version")) 
cellchat@DB <- CellChatDB.use

```

```{r}
cellchat <- subsetData(cellchat) # This step is necessary even if using the whole database
#cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
receiver = c("5", "2", "1")
geneset_oi <- cluster_de_each_vs_rest_hsc_1_5 %>% 
  filter(group1 %in% receiver, log_fc >= 1, padj < 0.0005) %>%
  group_by(group1) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = log_fc,n = Inf) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(feature) %>%
  unique() 
cellchat@var.features[["features"]] <- geneset_oi
cellchat <- identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat, variable.both = FALSE)
```

```{r}
cellchat <- computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean",trim = 0.1,raw.use = TRUE)
```

```{r}
cellchat <- filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 20)
```

```{r}
cellchat <- aggregateNet(cellchat)
```

```{r}
ptm = Sys.time()
groupSize <- as.numeric(table(cellchat@idents))
par(mfrow = c(1,2), xpd=TRUE)
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$count, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Number of interactions")
netVisual_circle(cellchat@net$weight, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, label.edge= F, title.name = "Interaction weights/strength")
```

```{r}
mat <- cellchat@net$weight
par(mfrow = c(3,4), xpd=TRUE)
for (i in 1:nrow(mat)) {
  mat2 <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(mat), ncol = ncol(mat), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  mat2[i, ] <- mat[i, ]
  netVisual_circle(mat2, vertex.weight = groupSize, weight.scale = T, edge.weight.max = max(mat), title.name = rownames(mat)[i])
}
```

```{r}
lapply(cellchat@netP$pathways, function(pathway){
  netAnalysis_contribution(cellchat, signaling =pathway)+ggtitle(pathway)
})

```

```{r}
lapply(cellchat@netP$pathways, function(pathway){
    pairLR.CXCL <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat, signaling = pathway, geneLR.return = TRUE)
    FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,pairLR.CXCL$geneLR, order = TRUE,split.by = "sample.name")&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()

})

```


```{r}

lapply(cellchat@netP$pathways, function(pathway){
  pairLR.CXCL <- extractEnrichedLR(cellchat, signaling = pathway, geneLR.return = FALSE)
  LR.show <- pairLR.CXCL[1,] # show one ligand-receptor pair
# Hierarchy plot
  vertex.receiver = seq(1,4) # a numeric vector
  netVisual_individual(cellchat, signaling = pathway,  pairLR.use = LR.show, vertex.receiver = vertex.receiver)
#> [[1]]
# Circle plot
  netVisual_individual(cellchat, signaling = pathway, pairLR.use = LR.show, layout = "circle")
})



```

```{r}
# Compute the network centrality scores
cellchat <- netAnalysis_computeCentrality(cellchat, slot.name = "netP") # the slot 'netP' means the inferred intercellular communication network of signaling pathways

```

```{r}
# Visualize the computed centrality scores using heatmap, allowing ready identification of major signaling roles of cell groups
netAnalysis_signalingRole_network(cellchat, signaling = "GALECTIN", width = 8, height = 2.5, font.size = 10)

```

```{r}
# Signaling role analysis on the aggregated cell-cell communication network from all signaling pathways
ht1 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "outgoing")
ht2 <- netAnalysis_signalingRole_heatmap(cellchat, pattern = "incoming")
ht1 + ht2
```
